entities.name: 5GMM-NULL
entities.description: Initial state of the 5GMM sublayer when no NAS signalling connection exists.

entities.name: 5GMM-DEREGISTERED
entities.description: State where the UE is not registered with the network but may attempt registration.

entities.name: 5GMM-REGISTERED
entities.description: State where the UE is successfully registered with the network and can exchange user data.

entities.name: 5GMM-SERVICE-REQUEST-INITIATED
entities.description: Transitional state entered when the UE initiates a service request procedure.

entities.name: 5GMM-DEREGISTERED-INITIATED
entities.description: Transitional state entered when the UE initiates a deregistration procedure.

relations.description: Transition from 5GMM-NULL to 5GMM-DEREGISTERED state occurs when NAS signalling connection is established.
Transition from 5GMM-DEREGISTERED to 5GMM-REGISTERED state occurs upon successful registration.
Transition from 5GMM-REGISTERED to 5GMM-SERVICE-REQUEST-INITIATED state occurs when service request procedure is initiated.
Transition from 5GMM-REGISTERED to 5GMM-DEREGISTERED-INITIATED state occurs when deregistration procedure is initiated.
